R4F-grouse-walk-0001.name: 150 m N of Quartz Creek
R4F-grouse-walk-0001.pressureWhy: 4.7 km on foot from the nearest parking (estimate).
R4F-grouse-walk-0001.parkWhat: pull off on Quartz Creek FSR (gravel road)

evidence.t: Trail: Prairie Hills trail, 4.7 km stretch.
100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
7 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
6 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 4 table (pages 39 and 40), so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis). Pages 36 to 41 print no LEH list.

plan: Drive: from Mica Creek, about 141 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 51.41295, -117.3271, pull off on Quartz Creek FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: the Prairie Hills trail stretch, 4.7 km one way. About 94 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).

Legal: MU (Management Unit) 4-34, Region 4. No baiting in Region 4. Season: grouse Sept 1 to Nov 30 and more rows (synopsis page 39, 99%). 2 legal flags below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-10, closures 2026-10-16.
R4F-grouse-walk-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 4-34: about 8,787 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 2.18 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: a long walk from parking. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.1 km and about 3 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
